description: INFLUENCE — the check requests you filed, newest first. Requires a key or login — an anonymous caller has no identity to scope a list to, and should read a single request with check_status instead. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.
